selfReview.type: AI own-locale direct Japanese semantic comparison and continuous Khmer teaching-prose review
selfReview.method: Read complete effective Japanese paragraphs, lesson metadata, questions/options/rationales and seven full case readings. Translate directly and compare every field against source. Read connected Khmer explanations and cases, then every option-specific reason, for complete natural syntax, respectful adult roles and preservation of conditions, uncertainty, negation, actors, recipients, time, numbers, sequence and clinical/individual-plan/training/product limits. Final binding/count/terminology/reading and prior-file checks follow semantic edits.
semanticChecks: Team coordination begins with desired life, concrete difficulties and observed facts; profession name alone does not convey the needed support. PT basic body movement, OT life activities, ST language/communication/swallowing roles retained without treating one profession as responsible for every issue. Distinguish successful/difficult parts and conditions, keeping cause/diagnosis unknown. Report sent, recipient receipt, advice confirmation and plan change are separate. Ask unclear advice and confirm who does which support and permitted changes before action. Share only necessary information to necessary people centered on wishes. No care-worker diagnosis, independent rehabilitation exercises or food/drink alteration merely from a report. Kai case retains club wish, both manual sorting and speaking-before-group difficulties, one-line PT message and undiagnosed cause. Full question reading additionally preserves unconfirmed new support plan.

Record sources separately: person-reported fatigue/wishes, worker observations and measurements complement rather than replace one another. Observation time is not known onset; unobserved intervals and range are not invented. Not measured remains not measured. Worker feels hot versus room measurement versus person’s temperature are distinct; impression/action is not established cause. Near miss/hazard without injury still requires reporting/follow-up and team examination of environment/equipment/method without premature blame. Unsupported conclusion corrected transparently by facility method, not unauthorized deletion. No diagnostic/procedural number threshold invented; urgent aid/contact must not wait for polished writing. Lien case preserves14:00, fatigue statement, two pauses folding towels, no measurement, unsupported fever-from-hot-room conclusion and reporting change to assigned staff.

Hand hygiene method chosen from visible soil, recent contact and next task, not product proximity/speed. Visible soil requires running water and soap. Both hands include palms, backs, interdigital areas, thumbs, fingertips/nail margins; rings/watches follow facility rules, count alone is not coverage evidence. Soap washing includes rinse and appropriate drying. Rub disinfection follows product quantity/method, distributed and rubbed until dry without wiping off prematurely. Later dirty towel/surface contact may recontaminate; new contacts and timing rechecked. Gloves do not replace hygiene. Product/pathogen-dependent choice, amount/time follow facility infection measures, product instructions and workplace training; no self-designed procedure. Full case reading preserves next handling of a clean-supply container and both colleagues’ proposals, not only the visibly soiled hand scenario.

Worker capacity includes posture, person’s abilities, work area, equipment, staff count and role division before accepting work. Wide stance alone is not permission for safe solo transfer. Own back pain/fatigue/unsafe condition reported to assigned staff; hiding pain and relying on force risks worker and recipient. Lift/sliding sheet matched to person/task, inspected before use and used by trained method. Storage availability does not establish model training or team roles. Report missing experience and confirm operator/plan/helpers. For full-assistance lifting consider lifts and methods avoiding manual lifting. Scope is pre-task consultation, not lifting/pulling/transfer/body fulcrum technique; individual assessment, equipment handling and field training required, no unknown solo trials. Case/readings retain today’s back pain, untrained sheet model and the colleague’s posture-only assertion as an assertion, not endorsed advice.

Disaster preparedness also covers usable route, communication, who helps whom and accessible information, not stocked bag alone. Attendance count is not safe completion. Unreachable assigned person and unusable route recorded separately. Facility-plan follow-up identifies incomplete work, report recipient and actual accepting responder; roster assignment is not acceptance. No unconfirmed substitute/route invented. Confirm correction owner and time/method to test effect. Tidying/recontacting action is distinct from verified usable route/information receipt/connected assistance. Follow through to next drill/plan review. No universal evacuation order for earthquake/fire/wind/flood; actual trained facility response/instructions apply and action does not wait for the learning report. Case and full reading preserve hearing-support recipient, assigned person not reached, cart-blocked impassable planned route and stocked/checked items as separate states.

Expression/behavior are clues to ask, not proof of sadness/anger/refusal. Nonleading questions confirm feelings and current wishes. Desire for activity differs from noise/hunger/fatigue/anxiety barriers, which can overlap; no single guessed cause explains all reactions. Meaningful small choices include participation form/song/topic/when/with whom within actual options/conditions. Count or worker praise is not person’s satisfaction. Confirmed wishes, possible support and unchecked conditions remain distinct. Wanting solitude now is not rejection of all future contact. Need models/expressions are not psychological diagnosis or definitive capacity judgment; consult individual plan, convey concrete continuing problems/changes to necessary assigned staff. Full music case retains observed low speech/door gaze, initial worker assumption, person’s own noise explanation and both solitude and song-choice wishes.

Memory encoding, retention and recall distinguished, as are semantic knowledge, episodic experience and procedural skill. One task success/failure does not determine every process; towel skill is not evidence of new schedule memory. When new information cannot be answered, check accessible delivery, hearing, content and question comprehension before a memory-only explanation. Separate observed skill/answer/explanation setting/unknown parts; discuss brief explanation, quiet place and usable communication method and assess within that task. No diagnosis from one forgotten schedule and no guarantee all memory normal from familiar skill. Not a substitute for dementia testing or decision-capacity evaluation. Case/full reading retain noisy-room timing, freshly told activity time unanswered, skilled towel folding and worker’s all-normal inference as an inference.

All seven effective readings fully translated as distinct case documents, not blank, omitted, compressed or replaced by the related but different lesson case paragraph. All seven lesson contexts are exact own translations of their identical Japanese source paragraphs. Seven art captions retain context-only limits: no profession/advice inference, full hand process not certified, empty-bed scene not solo lift method, stocked bag not contact/route completion, expression not intent and one skill/art not whole-memory diagnosis. Caption button operation remains generic button use, with no invented garment-buttoning action. No figure-caption keys in source. Seven questions retain28 full options and28 specific rationales with fixed correctIndex.
